channel.title: Is there a canon history of The Foundation?
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Is there a canon history of The Foundation?" - Is there like a load of 'facts' like it was founded then or this site does this.

item.title: Re: Is there a canon history of The Foundation?
Re: Is there a canon history of The Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
So, is there a list of sites and do they have specialisation?

There is, but people pay attention to/ignore them as they feel.

On a given article, might get pushback from one or two people claiming that Site 437 is only for the containment of crocodilian objects or that Site 28 is for the assessment of gas-based SCP objects. Ignore this criticism, as it is pedantry disguising itself as analysis and is fundamentally unserious.

In terms of general history, not really. There are loads of different interpretations of how it was founded, when, where, why, and by who, but none of them are any more correct than any other. In fact, there's even a canon in which there is no Foundation. Go wild.

item.title: Is there a canon history of The Foundation?
item.content:encoded:
So, is there a list of sites and do they have specialisation?
Like site-19 crops up a lot but why? Is there a list of facilities used by the foundation?
Surely there has to be some common-ground everyone stems from? Eg: 'Site-05 doesn't exist'
Or is it literally just make it sound convincing and no one really cares.
I ask cos I'm thoroughly expecting to write something and then someone goes *pushes glasses up nose* "Well actually.."
I'm sorry if it isn't very clear plz don't hurt me
